fact: Presenting the government's twelve projects on 14 July 2026, the ministry said the 'Zéro donnée à l'extérieur' project strengthens the G-Cloud with two redundant mini data centres, a Tier III national data centre tender planned for 2026 and repatriation of public data hosted abroad to begin that year.
title: SIPEN-UEMOA 2026 : construire un État connecté
